sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS parentProductSku, fv.SKU AS variantSku, fv.ProductName AS variantName, cat.CategoryValue AS category, bdl.BrandName AS brand, tx.sd AS shortDescription, tx.ld AS details, COALESCE(tx.sp, tx.psp) AS specifications, tx.sh AS shippingInfo, cf.ai AS additionalInfo, gp.price AS price, t1.Quantity AS tier1Qty, t1.Price AS tier1Price, t2.Quantity AS tier2Qty, t2.Price AS tier2Price, t3.Quantity AS tier3Qty, t3.Price AS tier3Price, po.InStockMsg AS inStockMessage, sw.val AS swatches, lnk.fb AS frequentlyBought, lnk.ym AS youMayAlsoLike FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeLocale loc ON loc.IsDefault = @defaultLocale LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalProfile anon ON anon.PortalId = po.PortalId AND anon.IsDefaultAnonymousProfile = @anonymousProfile CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 v.PimProductId, v.SKU, v.ProductName, v.Brand FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct v ON v.PimProductId = a.PimProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = v.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND v.IsActive = @isActive AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId GROUP BY v.PimProductId, v.SKU, v.ProductName, v.Brand HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed ORDER BY v.SKU) fv LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetails bd ON bd.BrandCode = fv.Brand LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetailLocale bdl ON bdl.BrandId = bd.BrandId AND bdl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 cvl.CategoryValue FROM dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct cp INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryAttributeValue cav ON cav.PimCategoryId = cp.PimCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute ca ON ca.PimAttributeId = cav.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryAttributeValueLocale cvl ON cvl.PimCategoryAttributeValueId = cav.PimCategoryAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy ch ON ch.PimCategoryId = cp.PimCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCatalog pc ON pc.PimCatalogId = ch.PimCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pcat ON pcat.PublishCatalogId = pc.PublishCatalogId WHERE cp.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ca.AttributeCode = @categoryNameCode AND cvl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId AND pcat.PortalId = po.PortalId ORDER BY cp.DisplayOrder, cvl.CategoryValue) cat OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN x.r = @variantRank AND x.c = @shortDescriptionCode THEN x.v END) AS sd, MAX(CASE WHEN x.r = @variantRank AND x.c = @detailsCode THEN x.v END) AS ld, MAX(CASE WHEN x.r = @variantRank AND x.c = @specificationsCode THEN x.v END) AS sp, MAX(CASE WHEN x.r = @parentRank AND x.c = @specificationsCode THEN x.v END) AS psp, MAX(CASE WHEN x.r = @variantRank AND x.c = @shippingInfoCode THEN x.v END) AS sh FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN av.PimProductId = fv.PimProductId THEN @variantRank ELSE @parentRank END AS r, pa.AttributeCode AS c, COALESCE(ta.AttributeValue, avl.AttributeValue) AS v FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue ta ON ta.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId AND ta.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale avl ON avl.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId AND avl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId WHERE av.PimProductId IN (fv.PimProductId, p.PimProductId)) x) tx OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pl.PriceListId, COALESCE(pr.SalesPrice, pr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePriceList pl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePrice pr ON pr.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListProfile plf ON plf.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plf.PortalProfileId = anon.PortalProfileID LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plo.PortalId = po.PortalId WHERE pr.SKU = fv.SKU AND (plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL OR plo.PriceListPortalId IS NOT NULL) AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY CASE WHEN plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL THEN @profileListRank ELSE @storeListRank END, plf.Precedence, plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId) gp OUTER APPLY (SELECT t.Quantity, t.Price FROM dbo.ZnodePriceTier t WHERE t.PriceListId = gp.PriceListId AND t.SKU = fv.SKU ORDER BY t.Quantity OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY) t1 OUTER APPLY (SELECT t.Quantity, t.Price FROM dbo.ZnodePriceTier t WHERE t.PriceListId = gp.PriceListId AND t.SKU = fv.SKU ORDER BY t.Quantity OFFSET 1 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY) t2 OUTER APPLY (SELECT t.Quantity, t.Price FROM dbo.ZnodePriceTier t WHERE t.PriceListId = gp.PriceListId AND t.SKU = fv.SKU ORDER BY t.Quantity OFFSET 2 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY) t3 OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(atl.AttributeName + @pairSeparator + dvl.AttributeDefaultValue, @listSeparator) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.DisplayOrder, pa.AttributeCode) AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeLocale atl ON atl.PimAttributeId = pa.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue pdv ON pdv.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValue dv ON dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = pdv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValueLocale dvl ON dvl.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId WHERE av.PimProductId = fv.PimProductId AND pa.IsConfigurable = @isConfigurable AND EXISTS (SELECT cpa.PimConfigureProductAttributeId FROM dbo.ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute cpa WHERE cpa.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cpa.PimAttributeId = pa.PimAttributeId) AND atl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId AND dvl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId AND pdv.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId) sw OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN la.AttributeCode = @frequentlyBoughtCode THEN lp.SKU + @skuNameSeparator + lp.ProductName END, @listSeparator) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lk.DisplayOrder, lp.SKU) AS fb, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN la.AttributeCode = @youMayAlsoLikeCode THEN lp.SKU + @skuNameSeparator + lp.ProductName END, @listSeparator) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lk.DisplayOrder, lp.SKU) AS ym FROM dbo.ZnodePimLinkProductDetail lk INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute la ON la.PimAttributeId = lk.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct lp ON lp.PimProductId = lk.PimProductId WHERE lk.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND lp.IsActive = @isActive) lnk OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 x.ai FROM (SELECT f.PimProductId, STRING_AGG(fl.CustomKey + @keyValueSeparator + fl.CustomKeyValue, @listSeparator) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.DisplayOrder, f.CustomCode) AS ai FROM dbo.ZnodePimCustomField f INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCustomFieldLocale fl ON fl.PimCustomFieldId = f.PimCustomFieldId AND fl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId WHERE f.PimProductId IN (fv.PimProductId, p.PimProductId) GROUP BY f.PimProductId) x ORDER BY CASE WHEN x.PimProductId = fv.PimProductId THEN @variantRank ELSE @parentRank END) cf WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) ORDER BY p.SKU
